title: Seagrove Beach "Golden Hour" 230 Dogwood St.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool * Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $40 per day.- 7 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Premium filtered drinking water system- 3 living areas- 5 Minute Low-Speed Vehicle ride to Publix- 1 Minute bike ride to Seaside- Gas grill and charcoal grill- Gas firepit in backyard- 2 Laundry Rooms- Wet bar- Pool table - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, and laundered upon every checkout.DETAILS: Discover the beauty of Seagrove Beach at Golden Hour, a luxurious Dutch farmhouse-inspired home with 7 elegant bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms, sleeping 20. Experience an idyllic getaway filled with leisurely walks to Seaside for shopping and dining, breezy bike rides along the Timpoochee Trail, and kayaking adventures on Eastern Lake—only a 6-minute (or 2-minute bike ride) from the nearest beach access. With luxury and comfort in mind, a large screened-in porch, private pool, and gas firepit provide everything needed for an incredible 30A getaway!Modeled after the charming coastal homes of Cape Cod and Nantucket, this gorgeous 3-story retreat features hardwood floors, shiplap walls, and vintage touches that bring a coastal bygone era back to life. The Sonos sound system sets the mood for any vacation as guests sink into cloud-soft furniture for family movie nights in the open living area. A wet bar with a wine fridge simplifies hosting, while the 8-person dining table and 4-stool breakfast bar ensure enough room for everyone. Pale blues and creamy whites with brass finishes adorn the gourmet kitchen, boasting high-end appliances—including a La Cornue French oven, 6-burner cooktop and highest quality filtered drinking water. Step onto the screened porch, where comfortable wicker furniture and a natural gas grill overlook the garden for perfect alfresco dining. Beyond the porch is a swoon-worthy pool with a fully turfed deck and nearby firepit for cozy Summer evenings under the stars. Laid-back opulence awaits in the 2 first-floor bedrooms, both with king beds and private bathrooms, and 1 with a free-standing soaking tub for added luxury.The second-floor landing opens to a sunlit sitting area ideal for watching TV or playing Backgammon. This floor features 3 lovely guest bedrooms with king beds and 2 versatile bunk rooms with twin-over-full beds, each with a 32" TV.Enjoy the third-floor game room, boasting a 55" TV, 2 queen sleeper sofas, pool table, and vintage video game console with a classic catalog of games—including Pac-Man and Donkey Kong! There’s also a laundry room for convenience.Guests of Golden Hour will enjoy on-site parking for 4 vehicles—plus 7 complimentary bikes and a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle—for easy trips to the beach and other 30A communities. For beach access, it's a short walk down Dogwood Street! Book this stunning getaway today!*Please note: As of February 2026, final-stage construction is occurring several homes away and across the street; minimal impact expected and will be concluded with 30 days.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 20):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Half Bathroom: Toilet Only- Half Bathroom Outside: Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: Twin/Full Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: Twin/Full Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:Additional Living Area: 2 Queen Sleeper Sofas
